description: Preinstalled redistributable VidMuse asset baseline. Types are declared in types.json; per-pack ledgers live in packs/<id>/pack.json; index.json is the derived query surface.

core-pack.description: Packs this plugin redistributes. Full ledger: upstream version, license receipt, per-file hashes.

media-use-sfx.description: Read-only index of the bundled SFX media-use already owns. Files are never copied here; media-use keeps the provider and the doctor check.

design-palettes.description: Read-only index of VidMuse Design palette seeds. Design owns color intent; Assets exposes one query surface without copying the data.

packs.role: offline-fallback for the live logo cascade
